Current State: Access provisioning and termination processes exist but recurring review evidence is inconsistent
Gap Identified: Inactive or inappropriate user access may remain enabled
Business Impact: Unauthorized access may persist and create security or compliance exposure
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly access reviews and strengthen termination access removal

Current State: Privileged roles exist but business justification and review evidence are incomplete
Gap Identified: Some users may retain excessive elevated access
Business Impact: Compromised privileged accounts may enable broad unauthorized activity
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly privileged access reviews and document business justification

Current State: MFA is deployed but coverage is incomplete for some privileged accounts
Gap Identified: Not all applicable privileged access is protected by MFA
Business Impact: Compromised credentials may result in unauthorized privileged access
Recommended Remediation: Enforce MFA for all applicable accounts and document approved exceptions

Current State: Logs are centrally collected but recurring review documentation is inconsistent
Gap Identified: Monitoring activity cannot always be demonstrated
Business Impact: Suspicious activity may go undetected or lack investigation evidence
Recommended Remediation: Establish recurring log review procedures and retain review records

Current State: Most changes are documented but some testing evidence is incomplete
Gap Identified: Control operation cannot always be validated
Business Impact: Unauthorized or untested changes may introduce outages or security weaknesses
Recommended Remediation: Require test and approval evidence before implementation

Current State: Scanning and ticketing processes exist but some high-risk findings exceed remediation timelines
Gap Identified: High-risk vulnerabilities remain open too long
Recommended Remediation: Enforce severity-based remediation SLAs and formal risk acceptance for exceptions

Current State: Incident response procedures exist but documentation quality varies
Gap Identified: Some incident records lack complete evidence
Business Impact: Incomplete records may reduce auditability and lessons learned
Recommended Remediation: Implement a standardized incident documentation checklist

Current State: Incident response exercises are not performed consistently
Gap Identified: Response capability is not regularly validated
Business Impact: Response procedures may fail during a real incident
Recommended Remediation: Conduct annual tabletop exercises and track corrective actions

Current State: Risk assessments are performed but some treatment records are incomplete
Gap Identified: Some risks lack complete owner treatment or approval documentation
Business Impact: Material risks may remain unmanaged or lack accountability
Recommended Remediation: Require complete treatment decisions target dates and management approval

Current State: Vendor assessments occur but high-risk suppliers are not always reassessed on schedule
Business Impact: Changes in vendor security posture may remain unidentified
Recommended Remediation: Establish annual reassessment requirements for high-risk vendors

Current State: Backups are performed but restoration testing is inconsistent
Business Impact: Systems or data may not be recoverable after disruption
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly restoration testing and retain recovery evidence

Current State: Policies exist but some exceed scheduled review dates
Business Impact: Outdated policies may not reflect current risks or requirements
Recommended Remediation: Implement centralized policy review tracking and automated reminders

Current State: Asset records exist but some applications are not consistently inventoried or classified
Business Impact: Untracked systems may fall outside security monitoring and compliance scope
Recommended Remediation: Perform recurring inventory reconciliation and assign ownership and classification

Current State: General security controls exist but privacy-specific obligations are not fully integrated
Gap Identified: Privacy requirements may not be fully addressed
Business Impact: Personal data may be handled without complete governance or documented accountability
Recommended Remediation: Create dedicated privacy governance procedures including data inventory lawful basis retention and rights processes

Current State: Retention rules exist but vary by system and data type
Gap Identified: Retention and disposal requirements are inconsistently documented
Business Impact: Data may be retained too long or disposed of inconsistently
Recommended Remediation: Create a centralized retention schedule with owners disposal rules and review dates

Current State: Periodic access reviews occur but some findings lack closure evidence
Gap Identified: Unnecessary permissions may remain after review
Business Impact: Excessive access may remain active despite completed review cycles
Recommended Remediation: Require documented remediation evidence before access-review closure

Current State: Findings are tracked but validation evidence is not always required before closure
Gap Identified: Issues may be closed before corrective action is proven effective
Business Impact: Control weaknesses may remain unresolved while appearing closed
Recommended Remediation: Require independent validation and formal approval before closure

Current State: Compliance evidence is stored across multiple locations
Gap Identified: Evidence retrieval is inefficient and inconsistent
Business Impact: Audit readiness may be reduced and evidence may be missed
Recommended Remediation: Centralize evidence storage and define naming ownership and retention standards
